content: in november 2020 a civil case was heard in the vilnius regional district court involving three parties the plaintiff the defendant and a third party the plaintiff is seeking a certain amount of money from the defendant and there are three different costs that need to be paid the court has decided to dissolve the marriage and divide the jointly owned funds equally between the applicant and defendant the applicant has requested various matters to be resolved including retaining their married name receiving compensation for nonmaterial damage declaring debts related to student loans establishing the residence of their minor child ordering child maintenance payments establishing a communication procedure for the child and having the defendant pay for the applicants costs the defendant agrees to the childs residence and paying child maintenance the court determines that the parties property and obligations should be divided equally the applicant is exempt from paying certain fees and the defendant is ordered to pay the applicants legal aid costs the court grants the request to dissolve the marriage and divides the movable and immovable property and joint obligations between the parties the applicant is awarded half of the jointly owned funds while the defendant is also awarded half the defendant is ordered to pay compensation for nonmaterial damage stamp duty and legal aid costs the applicant is responsible for paying the costs incurred by the defendant
